name: g_ArcEntryCount
comment: number of BUILD.TOC entries (15219); checked against the TOC file size in Arc_Init

name: g_ArcDatSector
comment: start sector of BUILD.DAT on disc; added to each entry's sector

name: g_ArcDiscOk
comment: 1 when BUILD.TOC/BUILD.DAT were found and the TOC size matched

name: g_ArcHeap
comment: heap the TOC buffer is allocated from

name: g_MenuInput
comment: menu pad input state; [2]/[4] are pressed/held masks (MenuWnd_Alloc)

name: s_RaceUiSpriteCursor
comment: sprite write cursor used by the RaceUi draw helpers

name: s_GarageSortProfile
comment: profile index used by the GarageSort_* comparators

name: s_RaceIsReplayMode
comment: 1 when RaceCtx mode is 0xd (set in RaceTask_BeginLoading)
